annotations.title: Check auto insurer financial strength and complaint lookup

description: Factual carrier standing lookup for US auto insurers: verified AM Best or Demotech financial strength rating status (active, withdrawn, or not rated), underwriting subsidiary notes, eligibility restrictions, public regulatory context, and direct NAIC Consumer Insurance Search lookup guidance (where the NAIC Complaint Index uses 1.00 as the national baseline relative to market share: below 1.00 = fewer complaints than expected, above 1.00 = more). Optionally pass state to cross-reference presence in RateZip's 10-state .gov pricing study. Carriers outside the verified registry return unknown rather than estimated ratings. Use to verify an insurer's financial strength and complaint lookup instructions; use get_state_auto_benchmarks for state .gov price spreads, or compare_auto_quotes to compare caller-supplied quotes. Factual reference data only; does not endorse insurers.

carrier_name.description: Auto insurance brand or underwriting company name (e.g. 'First Acceptance', 'GEICO Secure', 'CSAA', 'Tesla Insurance', 'Branch').

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code or state name to cross-reference presence in RateZip's 10-state .gov study.

name: check_auto_carrier_quality

financial_strength.description: Verified AM Best / Demotech rating status, category, outlook, and verification date.

found.description: True when matched in RateZip's verified AM Best / Demotech carrier registry; false when left unknown.

naic_complaint_guidance.description: NAIC Consumer Insurance Search lookup guidance (1.00 = national complaint baseline relative to market share; <1.00 fewer complaints than expected, >1.00 more).

state_study_presence.description: Optional cross-reference to the carrier's presence in RateZip's 10-state .gov pricing study.
